'''Edward Talon-Crow''' is a [[Sim]] available for download from [[The Sims 4 Gallery]].<ref>[https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/pddoLXBnR%2F%2BTL8aOSQ6%2FzQ Enemies to... Enemies? by Maxis]</ref>

Edward is the ex-husband of Pernilla Lunvik ([[Greg|Greg's]] mother, a lore character from ''[[The Sims 4: Werewolves]]''). Below are the mentions of their relationship from objects in the ''[[The Sims 4: Life & Death]]'' :

* "Some crows sing grandiose songs! A beautiful large rug by the famous textile giant, Lunvik's Loom. It's rumored that Pernilla Lunvik created these more macabre-inspired designs as a nod to (or perhaps in spite of) her former lover, Edward Talon-Crow, when he left San Myshuno after they broke up."
* "The dying candle flickered on Edward Talon-Crow's desk. He scrawled furiously with his feather quill by the candle's dull amber glow, seated on his favorite chair. Though he often referred to his favorite chair as "The Seat of Inspiration" today it seemed more like a castle spire, a viewpoint of defensive advantage and offensive pressure.  To call his fellow writers "peers" would be a stretch. They were talentless hacks, catering their inane drivel to the whims of the masses. That day, his most bitter rival, Fulov Pepp, had the ''gall'' to publish a criticism of Edward's macabre themes. Rich, coming from a man whose most recent short story was about a cute puppy learning to walk. No grit, no grime, no realism. Just another gauche attempt at pulling the heartstrings of his gullible readers. The rebuttals wrote themselves, it seemed. His quill raced across the parchment, his counterattack mounting with each impassioned word.  Pernilla's last words before leaving him rang achingly in his mind as he wrote.  "''One day, Eddie, you'll amount to something. It's a shame I won't be around to see it''."   "One day. One day he'd prove himself, as a writer, as a Sim!"
* ''An excerpt from the essay "The Stairs of Ruin" by Edward Talon-Crow, published one week after being dumped by San Myshuno furniture mogul Pernilla Lunvik, who famously ran off with her spellcaster paramour.''  "We ascend the stairs of life and death unendingly, every ounce of effort lost to the ether as we toil forever. When is this loss ever more painful than in the form of unrequited love? Few things appall me more than watching my efforts be taken, stomped in the dirt, and left to wither by someone who once claimed to love me.  Bitter are the days I've survived recently. The air in this accursed city reeks of shady industry, broken dreams, and more heinously, ''magic''. I once beheld modern magic as a joyous advancement for Simkind, but now the wicked art leaves me wishing for a simpler age. I daresay we have ascended these stairs to unsustainable heights! Mark my words, there is little good to come of spellcasting, only melancholy!  Perhaps I shall find my respite in the quiet hills of another horizon, far away from this city of smog-tinged sadness."

*'''Vanessa''': Coined from Esther Vanhomrigh (Van + Es → Vanessa).
*'''Marie''': French form of Mary, directly derived from Latin Maria, meaning "bitter", "beloved," "rebelliousness," "wished-for child", "marine".

'''Michael Bell''' is a pre-made [[Non-playable character|NPC]] residing in [[Henford-on-Bagley]], the [[world]] shipped with ''[[The Sims 4: Cottage Living]]''. He is not the most romantic [[Sim]], as it has been heard that he had a very awkward date with [[Cecilia Kang]], another local resident. He is the local creature keeper and does not live on a lot, but his cottage can be found in the forest in [[The Bramblewood]] and he may spawn on other lots (such The Gnome's Arms) even if the Sims in the current household have not met him yet. 

Michael is an [[adult]], 39 days away from becoming an [[elder]]. His overall role is to watch over the animals of the village, as he is surrounded by many [[Wild bird|wild birds]], [[Rabbit|rabbits]], and [[Fox|foxes]]. As with the other special villager roles, the Creature Keeper has special abilities and interactions with player-controlled Sims. These include: 

* '''Offer Help With [[Errand|Errands]]'''
* Friendly > Have a Henford Heart-to-Heart 
* Friendly > Offer Finchwick Favor... 
* '''Animal Clothing...''' 
** Ask to Craft Animal Clothing... (requires llama wool in the Sims' inventory)
** Buy Animal Clothing...  
* '''Trade berries...''' (He will give a blueberry, raspberry, or chocoberry in exchange for 2 of one of the other types of berries. For example, Sims can give him 2 raspberries for a chocoberry)
* Friendly > '''Sell Foraged Plants''' (He will happily buy berries & mushrooms for a significant markup, including perfect nightly mushrooms for §201 each)
**Currently, there's a bug where the player can offer to sell more than 10 items and will get the money for all those items, but only have 10 items removed from their inventory. The easiest workaround is to only sell 10 items at a time.

===[[file:Ravenwood Rumors.png|30px|link=]] Ravenwood Rumors===
Lady Ravendancer, like other citizens of Ravenwood, has a special interaction called ''Ravenwood Rumors'' that reveals tidbits of lore relating to herself, her ancestry, or the town's history. For most Sims, the information revealed depends on the relationship score with the player's Sim, but Lady Ravendancer's Ravenwood Rumors are all available from the get-go, regardless of her relationship score.

*"Would you believe there are people around that still associate me with the founding of this lovely little area? Picture it: Ages ago, right here in [[Ravenwood]], well before anything was here of course, I'm just traipsing along minding my own business when ''suddenly'' I turn around, and these filthy, hungry Sims were following me! I, of course, took pity and gave them a [[Tarot cards|Tarot]] Reading. Eventually they got distracted by some stray goat and left me alone."
*"[[Zelmira Gomes]] was able to summon me once they'd collected all of my special Tarot cards. What an interesting individual; of course, our family tree has intertwined roots going all the way back to [[Lolita Goth]], so it makes sense that there some commonalities between us."
*"The interesting thing about being a ghost is that a lot of time can pass in a blink. Back when this area was named after Ravens, it made sense; my family was on the ascendance and there were ravens, not crows. Now, time has passed and I see that the crows from Grim's aviary have taken over. Perhaps a century from now, it will be back in the hands (or talons) of ravens!"
*"Once a week—on Wednesdays, I believe—the living and the dead gather together to celebrate the link between their worlds at the Thinned Festiveil. Of course, one must bring a gift for the tree if they attend! My relative, Zelmira, has given tarot readings there before. They certainly have a flair for it!"

Does Not Trigger Jealousy |boundaries = Exploring }} ==Ravenwood Rumors==
Did you know that I spearhead the Ravenwood Welcoming Committee? That's right, sometimes I sacrifice a day's worth of vital sales just to show up with Pan de Muerto and regale you with wonderful information about the community. I usually rope a few other folks into coming with me. Everyone complains about the script I wrote, but I'm a guy who feels that anything worth doing is worth doing my way.
When I was alive, I had so many friends. More than I do now, even. Of course, my charm has only grown over the years, but I was perfectly charming centuries ago, too. So I ask you: what sort of friends don’t throw their friend one simple funeral upon death? That’s right. I received no funeral. Nada! It hurts a little. You grind day after day, offering the best warez that Ravenwood has to offer, and what reward awaits you? Well, maybe someday someone will throw me a funeral. A sim can dream.
I’ve seen it all over the years when it comes to death. Rabid rodents, cowplants, poison, crows - death, death, death, death, death! And so many are so, well, dramatic and unexpected. I suppose it’s a blessing that I just chose to go out peacefully on my own while I was in bed. Though I’ll tell you, there were times I was worried that the mold in my old flat would take me out!
I like to think of myself as the undesignated, unasked-for guardian of the Crypt here, so trust me; I know what everyone gets up to when they're in there. That's right, that's right; when you WooHoo in there, you're shaming yourself! Oh, c'mon. I'm kidding. What, you think I've never had an amorous thought in my life?
Lady Ravendancer Goth and I go way back. Way back. Way, way back. We're super close. Sure, she rolls her eyes at me constantly, but that's because it's hard for another Sim to stand across from me without recognizing that my charisma is quite simply unmatched.
One thing you can never, ever be without: a casket! used, new—does it matter? Okay, it might matter. Not the point. You need a casket, and you need one now—so you'd better check out the Try Before You Die Casket Sake to get all set up.

Like other San Sequoia townies, Kyle has a special interaction under Friendly/Gossip called ''"San Sequoia Secrets"'' that will reveal tidbits of lore pertaining to his personal history or the town's history. Depending on your relationship level with Kyle, different secrets will be revealed.

====0-32 Relationship Points====
*I dunno, man. It's just been a week y'know? Just...you ever see something you just can't un-see or get out of your head? Last week I set my LlamaBerry PowerSip on a bench while I was doing pushups at the park and a squirrel came by and like...knocked it over. Full can. Total waste. I'm clawing my way back to normalcy man, but it's a long road.
*Word of advice: don't do your dishes in that splash pad thing at the park. Went out there for a sort of Simstagram hashtag simple living moment, ended up with a bunch of dogs fighting with me for scraps while some scandalized moms glared at me. Extremely bad vibes.
*I got banned from the movie theater last week. I'm hoping they don't ban me for long but it was such a crummy deal. You talk once in a movie—that, by the way, I was all by myself at cuz I guess it was the last-ever showing of The Llama Hums at Midnight and I was talkin' through a scary part and next thing I know the usher's telling me I'm banned?
*You ever go drive up to [[Moonwood Mill]]? Bro, ''those'' guys know how to party. I was about 6 PowerSips deep and all of a sudden they start gettin' rowdy, screamin' and taking off their shirts. Was totally awesome. Me and my boy Josh used to go hard way back, but that was nuts. Maybe its something in the water over there.
*People get so pressed about me doing pushups sometimes. They say things like "Why are you doing pushups right now" or "I'm calling the cops." Like just chill, doing pushups is like blinking for me, and we all gotta blink from time to time. Except for my boy Josh, yo he like never blinked. Was kinda creepy but also super rad.

====33-65 Relationship Points====
*You ever go to that Rec Center place? They built that up just recently I guess. Anyway, I see old people sometimes playing in there and I figured they were lonely so I sat down and played a game with them and it turns out I'm kind of a genius at that Simbles thing.
*I had pretty big dreams for myself once upon a time. You know I was [[Prom]] King at [[Copperdale]] my senior year? For real! It went a little downhill after I sort-of-kind-of-accidentally made a school toilet blow up. Don't ask about the toilet thing. I mean it. DON'T ask about the toilet thing!
*Hey, did you see all those fancy painted utility boxes all around Anchorpoint Wharf? I guess they got tired of someone who definitely isn't me tagging them and decided to paint 'em officially. Pretty sweet, though.
*I got this idea, right. You know how emojis kind of speak for themselves sometimes? Like instead of words? It's crazy right? What if we could somehow transfer that into like - real life, you know? I'm gonna do an "emoji face" right now, can you tell what I'm trying to say? — BRO no lie I think I'm onto something. I gotta write this down.
*I don't think of myself as a couch surfer, I think of myself as a couch-trepreneur. Shocked? Listen, I have about a billion startup ideas, I just— bwahaha, no, no, man, I'm so sorry, I gotta stop there. Startup ideas. Me? Can you imagine? No way. For starters, do I look like a guy who wants to wear those weird puffy vests? Haha yeah right - unless?

====66-100 Relationship Points====
*Alright, you keep asking me about that whole exploding toilet thing and I'm starting to feel guilty. Can I tell you the truth? I never made any toilet explode. Ever. It was just small misunderstanding with best boy Josh. But he thought it was the raddest thing ever, and went on to tell the rest of the boys. They loved it. I can never let them down. I will bear this shame. For the boys.
*You ever have a rough day? I don't have many, but when I do, I like to unwind with a plate of chicken nuggies and a bit of zoning out in front of the TV. I could watch sitcoms for hours, man.
*Dude, I gotta say, you're like the REALEST person I know. If I had to choose you between you and my best boy Josh— Whoa that thought just made me SUPER SAD. I cant choose between bros. I love all my bros equally! Ah shoot I got some of that "feeling sweat" in my eyes again, BRO I need a tissue.

At the end of the show, [[Caleb Vatore]] is chosen by Callia, but he rejects her and instead pulls Kyle in for a passionate kiss. This could imply that Kyle is attracted to men.

==Trivia==
* The name Fia is a short and increasingly popular feminine given name with multiple origins, primarily meaning "wild", "deer", or "flame". It is commonly used as an Anglicized version of the Irish name ''Fiadh'', representing untamed nature, or as a derivative of Italian/Latin names like ''Sofia'' (meaning wisdom) or ''Fiammetta'' (meaning little flame).
* Fia's gender is customized: she have a feminine frame, but prefers masculine clothing.
* She is the second pre-made burglar for ''[[The Sims 4]]'', the first being [[Robin Banks]].
* She shares her surname with [[Sergio Acosta]] from [[Monte Vista]] which could suggest a familial relation but how they are related, if at all, is unknown

'''Bruno Hoffman''' is a pre-made [[townie]] residing in [[Nordhaven]], the [[world]] shipped with ''[[The Sims 4: Businesses & Hobbies]]''. He lives with his grandson, [[Felix Hoffman|Felix]]. He is the owner and founder of the Hoffman's Candy Stall, which Felix now manages.  

==Nordhaven Family-Feud Gossip==
If a Sim chooses the gossip interaction under the friendly category, then "ask about feud" with the [[Loden family|Lodens]], he will say:

*''Calling us thieves, they're the real thieves. I can't believe the gall of them! We came up with the Jellybean Cookie, not them. It's OUR cookie.''
*''We used to be good friends, we even looked after [[Nora Loden|Nora]] when she was young. Then [[Gramma Hattie Loden|Hattie]]'s late husband called my wife a thief and cut all ties. I still can't believe he'd do that.''
*''I miss them a lot. But [[Gramma Hattie Loden|Hattie]]'s late husband called my wife a liar. I felt bad not going to the funeral but...I was pretty sure they hated me anyway, and all over that stupid cookie.''

==Share Nordhaven Noise==
If a Sim chooses the gossip interaction under the friendly category, then "share Nordhaven noise", he will say:

*''Have you ever spoken to [[Trashley Reelpearson|Trashley]]? I've never heard of anyone that talks like that before.''

== Nordhaven Family Feud Gossip ==
If a Sim chooses ''Gossip'' under the Friendly interaction category, then ''Ask about Feud with the Lodens...''

* ''It was difficult to trust them. They were nothing but catty with us after our families stopped hanging out. Why should we have to be nice to them?''

== Share Nordhaven Noise ==
If Sim chooses the Gossip interaction under the Friendly category, then Share Nordhaven Noise...

* ''A bunch of modern sculptures in [[Gammelvik]] were made by two local artist, Adrian and Isabela, when the [[Gammelvik#Konst Modern|Konst Modern]] was renovated. The community funded the whole thing.''
* ''I've seen [[Crispin Black|Crispin]] hang out near that dark alley in [[Iverstad]]. I wonder what's up with that.''

She later returned in ''[[The Sims 4: Royalty & Legacy]]'', though she is first mentioned in various Build and Buy items in ''[[The Sims 4]]''. She is the ancestor of the [[Capp family]], the [[Thebe family]], and the [[Laurent family]].

In Greek mythology, Queen was the unnamed wife of Eetion, and mother to Andromache, wife of Hector. Andromache and Hector appeared in Shakespeare's ''{{WP|Troilus and Cressida}}''. Some of her descendants in ''The Sims'' franchise bear her name.

==Biography==
As of [[The Sims 4/Patch 193|patch 193]], Queen Cordelia reappears in ''[[The Sims 4: Royalty & Legacy]]'' as an ancestral [[Sim]] for the [[Thebe family|Thebe]] and [[Capp family|Capp]] [[Dynasty|dynasties]], a type of Sim that cannot be found in the game itself, only in [[family tree]]s, and whose information is stored in the game files.<ref>Cordelia Thebe's entry is the instance "C64F155592BC7810" in the SimulationFullBuild0.package file in the EP21 folder.</ref> She was the Queen of [[Ondarion]] prior to her [[death|passing]].

Cordelia has the sweet [[voice]] type and a [[Fears|fear of the dark]].

===Backstory===
Cordelia is said to be a member of the Royal House Thebe, who lost her home in a terrible giant sloth invasion, survived a [[kraken]] attack, and used its power for her own purposes. As a [[child]], she was a world-renowned [[Marbles|marble]] champion, winning one marble while playing with a [[mermaid]] in the tide pools near her home.

She had a great love for jazz music and even had her own band, which featured a saxophone player named Jacob Goldentips, a [[bass]] player named Martin Maxwell, as well as two unnamed members (trumpet and [[piano]]), which she later discovered to be the Prince of [[Willow Creek]], Edward Terrance Bertrand, in disguise. The piano also happens to be Cordelia's favorite instrument.

She adored tea, and princes would come from across the lands to have tea with her, but she much preferred the company of pirate captains and would end up dating a total of three pirate captains throughout her life. 

Cordelia loved the ocean and would quite often be found spending her free time at the [[beach]], lounging by tide pools for hours. She enjoyed watching the delicate sea anemones in the waters and was amused by the way crabs would hastily scuttle away from gulls that circled in the skies above. She liked the taste of crab, but her favorite meal was scallops fried in garlic, which was first cooked for her aboard her private submersible by her first pirate boyfriend's chef.

Living in a palace, Cordelia had many staff to cater to her every need, from [[maid]]s to [[gardener]]s, and even her own furniture artisans and astronomers. Two notable members of her staff are her butler, [[Bob The Butler|Bob]], and her personal chef, [[Matilda The Cook|Matilda]]. Looks were important to Cordelia, and she would usually be seen wandering the palace grounds dressed in a bustle and corset with her hair up and embellished with a jeweled headdress.

===Cordelia's Palace===
[[File:Princess Cordelia's Enlarged AI Resize.jpg|left|thumb|487x487px|Cordelia's painting titled ''Land-Coral Garden'' shows a coastal town]]
Princess Cordelia lived in a grand palace that was on the coast of a vast kingdom. It is not mentioned where this kingdom is located; however, one of Cordelia's paintings of her painting studio shows a view of seaside buildings, so the kingdom may be located near the coast. It is mentioned that residents of the kingdom dressed quite formally, with the women wearing long dresses and the men wearing top hats. Cordelia mentions that there are a lot of [[cat]]s living throughout the kingdom, and she dislikes them because they make her sneeze. 

The royal house was adorned with vases of beautiful flowers, and Cordelia enjoyed painting pictures of them. She also loved the fragrant smells that they released, filling the halls of the palace.

Cordelia was well educated, and she had hundreds of books in the palace library. She also had her own painting studio filled with her many paintings and sculptures, and she even had her own private submersible, The Epsilon.

===The Great Sloth Invasion===
[[File:BobTheButterStatue Transparent.png|thumb|283x283px|Statue of Bob the Butler]]
The Great Sloth Invasion was a disaster that struck Cordelia's kingdom and forced its residents to evacuate those who did not perish due to the invading Giant Sloths. Cordelia was able to escape in time and took everything she could carry into her submersible along with her pirate boyfriend, Captain [[Long John Buttercups]] and his crew, and a handful of her own staff from the palace, including her furniture artisans. Despite having 48 rooms, The Epsilon quickly became full, and unfortunately, there was no room for her beloved jazz band, or her butler and personal chef. So with a heavy heart, she had to fire them. In memory, she painted a series of silhouettes of her jazz band and various other entertainers that were left behind, and had a sculpture of her [[butler]] made. The princess would go on to stay in a cottage in [[Henford-on-Bagley]].

===Henford-on-Bagley {{Vgversion|TS4:CoL}}===
[[File:Princess Cordelia's Peasants Stairs.png|thumb|200px|right|Peasants stairs]]
One of the first locations she settled in was [[Henford-on-Bagley]]. She spent a lot of time enjoying the countryside and a simpler way of life. It has been speculated that she spent her time at a cottage at the very top of [[the Bramblewood]]. She would have most likely wandered the world and swam in the River Bagley as well. Since she left most of her staff behind, she was also missing her stair butler who used to carry her on the stairs, so she had to climb them herself. As mentioned in her diary, she called them "Peasants stairs". The waterfalls in Henford-on-Bagley, known as '''Cordelia Falls''', share her namesake.

===Pirate Boyfriends===
Being a princess, Cordelia was regularly in the company of various princes, but she was much more interested in pirates. Throughout her life, she dated three pirate captains. The first was Captain [[Long John Buttercups]], but things did not work out with him as he was a little too fond of Cordelia's corset and was disgustingly unhygienic, even after Cordelia designed him a sink. Cordelia then met the handsome and well-groomed, yet unbearably vain Captain [[Chaz MacFreeling]], but she quickly tired of his narcissism (and obsessive mirror-looking) and broke things off with him. Her third boyfriend was the clumsy Captain [[Rodrigo De Pablo]], who was said to possibly be the greatest love of her life. He was always getting himself hurt whilst aboard The Epsilon, including burning his feet. Cordelia gave him a peg leg for this, but one time when they were sitting together by a fire, his peg leg caught on fire. On Cordelia's ottoman, it states, "At least he never suffered a broken heart." This means it is possible Rodrigo was killed in this incident, further supported by [[Camille Soto]]'s response through the ''Gravevine Gossip'' interaction. However, she also states people say Cordelia hired a witch to trap him in a glass bottle that she cast out to sea due to his apparent [[romantic (social type)|love]] [[affair]] with [[List of minor Sims#T|Lady Tartosa]]. Some also say he [[death|died]] choking on a tart, which Camille believes to be the least ridiculous explanation. His death would have been tragic for Cordelia, as he was said to be the greatest love of her life.

All three of Cordelia's pirate boyfriends had beloved parrots, and each captain had a plate crafted to commemorate their parrot. However, each time Cordelia broke up with the pirates, she was left stuck with the plate and soon had quite the collection. The item has a fourth plate for Cordelia's fourth boyfriend, who is referred to as JWBB in a carving from the Beard Beard Cave in Tomarang.{{Vgversion|TS4:FR}} This man is John Wilson a.k.a. Beard Beard the Pirate, author of the goal book, ''The Log of the Final Voyage of Beard Beard the Pirate,'' which can be found upon arriving on the second island in ''[[The Sims 2: Castaway]]''.

===Life on The Eppsilon===
Princess Cordelia loved the outdoors, so life on a submersible must have been difficult. She spent a lot of her time in her workshop designing pieces of furniture inspired by her experiences of the sea for her furniture artisans to craft, most of which were drawn from elements of ocean life and from creatures she saw through the submersible's windows. She also enjoyed sitting at her desk and dreamily writing about her pirate boyfriends in her journal. Cordelia wanted to know what time it was outside, so she designed a clock, but as she still didn't know if it was day or night, she fed it to a [[kraken]] that regularly attacked her ship with [[fire]]. She actually used the kraken's fire to fire a porcelain bathtub that she designed.

Cordelia travelled the world in her submersible, selling the furniture she created at the port they were docked at, and to determine where The Eppsilon was going to travel next, Cordelia would spin the globe in her room, and wherever it landed, she would tell her pilot to take her there. Cordelia loved the winter and would ask her pilot to bring the submersible to the surface so she could watch the cold water dripping from the icicles frozen to the hull.

===Sulani {{Vgversion|TS4:IL}}===
Princess Cordelia and Rodrigo De Pablo spent some time in [[Sulani]], where they faced off against [[List of minor Sims#M|Dread Pirate Morgan]]. 

Below are three aspects of their story found in the Buried Treasure collection from ''[[The Sims 4: Island Living|Island Living]]''. 

=====The Fingers of Sulani Buried Treasure=====
Princess Cordelia the Bold pondered her gift. Upon disembarking, a young islander girl ran to her with colored stones and a wicker brush. Now staring out a hut window across [[Lani St. Taz]] waters to the Sulani volcano beyond, she traced the wicker lines then finally ran it through her long hair. "Not as elegant as carved ivory, but charming nonetheless."

"I say again, Morgan will break parley to betray you." Captain Rodrigo De Pablo sat, sharpening his sabre. "We are vulnerable. Let me bring the armada's forces ashore." His silhouette was imposing but his vision rarely reached beyond his weapon's range.

''Yes'', Cordelia thought, ''we are on the sword's edge, but how small the reward if we never up the ante. Dread Pirate Morgan has a ruthless reputation but is out-bluffed as Rodrigo if she's here only for the treasure hoard. The real treasure is the Sulani Islands themselves''.

"You ''will'' keep the armada as is; ''armed and ready'' for the parley at the sun's high peak."

Rodrigo snorted, and Cordelia traced the lava flow as she continued brushing her hair.

=====The Eyes of Sulani Buried Treasure=====
The Dread Pirate Morgan stood on a ledge that jutted dangerously past the volcano lip and over lava below. Sulfur burned her nostrils. "Fire is cleansing," she remarked.

The [[Mua Pel'am]] islander made no response, but the ex-first mate of [[List of minor Sims#H|Captain Handwich]] sniffed. "A hot bath in the wooden tubs here cleans just as well," he disdainfully countered.

Morgan clenched the Sulani Island coin that beckoned her from across the seas. She held it up and fire-light rippled across its face, a crashing wave. "The work is always dirty, and we've just started," Morgan admonished. With a Sulani crew member translating her intentions, finding an ambitious island faction was straightforward. Handwich's crew was even easier to turn; the fool starved his crew then crashed his ship. Above all, Cordelia was the danger with her armada in range of [[Ohan'ali Town]]. She'll block off immediate sea routes when the parley goes south, but ships cannot sail over land.

Morgan turned to give the volcano maw one last look and final taunt. "Your gaze lured me here, Sulani, so I return this to you. Tomorrow, I will have all of your eyes." She flipped the coin into the lava and watched as it was consumed.

=====Sulani Island Curator Plaque=====
With the treasure securely in the hold of The Red Annie, her captain, the Dread Pirate Morgan, sailed to oceans unknown to pursue the next grand plunder while behind her, the Ohan'ali Town port lay razed to the ground after the calamitous parlay with Princess Cordelia the Bold, her captain, Rodrigo De Pablo, and the hapless Captain Sam Handwich.

From the ashes, Ohan'ali Town was reborn as the prominent destination it is today, and the Mutiny of Ohan'ali became a significant page in the Sulani Islands' history.

===Tartosa {{Vgversion|TS4:MWS}}===
[[Tartosa]] is most likely one of the later locations Cordelia visited, as Camille states she did not arrive with her first partner but with someone else, presumably Rodrigo De Pablo. During her time in Tartosa, Cordelia developed a close relationship with Lady Tartosa. Camille believes they were unlikely lovers due to Cordelia's feelings towards Rodrigo. Still, Cordelia and Lady Tartosa spent a lot of time together at the beach, sailing and devouring tarts. Sadly, their relationship ended on rocky terms, but nobody knows why. Some believe it's because Lady Tartosa had an [[affair]] with Rodrigo. Others say that she stiffed Cordelia with a tart, which was a serious offense back then. 

During Cordelia's time in Tartosa, a local shipwright carved the likeness of Princess Cordelia and Rodrigo De Pablo into the figurehead of a ship. When the ship sank, those who remembered their love carried it to the top of the hill by Hideaway Falls as a reminder. A year passed, and it magically began to sprout leaves and branches, which was seen as a sign that their love lived on even though Rodrigo had passed. This tree came to be known as the Lover's Tree to the locals.

It is unknown why Cordelia left Tartosa; some say she was afraid of the sloth invasion coming to Tartosa, as they were known to be strong swimmers. Or that simply she was truly an adventurer at heart who could not stay in one place for too long. It could also possibly be the loss of her greatest [[romantic (social type)|love]], Rodrigo, that made her leave. However, it is known that after she left, she was one of the first [[Sim]]s to explore the arctic waters in her submersible, The Epsilon. It could also be presumed that during this time, she gave birth to a [[child]] known as [[Rodrigo Thebe]], the ancestor of [[Arnessa Thebe]], who remains in Tartosa with [[Laurent family|her family]].

===Ondarion {{Vgversion|TS4:R&L}}===
Princess Cordelia is revealed to be the original Princess Cordelia I and now has multiple descendants. One being [[Cordelia Thebe V|Cordelia V]], a legendary navigator. Like her ancestor, she is an intrepid seafaring socialite with a taste for lavish gatherings, amassed riches, and complicated affairs. Her other descendants in Ondarion include members of the [[Capp family]], siblings [[Juliette Monty|Juliette]] and [[Tybalt Capp|Tybalt]] and their children.

It is also revealed that Princess Cordelia I famously took not one, not two, but four pirate lovers. From two of these unions came children, a legacy that helped shape [[Verdemar]]'s cosmopolitan spirit. Later she [[marriage|married]] [[Eetion Thebe]] and had [[Andromache Thebe]], the mother of the late Grand Duke [[Consort Capp]].

==Biography==
Queen resided during her lifetime in [[Veronaville]], one of the [[neighborhood]]s shipped with ''[[The Sims 2]]''. She was the wife of [[Eetion Thebe|Eetion]], the mother of [[Andromache Thebe|Andromache]], the grandmother of [[Consort Capp]] {{Nee|Thebe|male}}, the great-grandmother of [[Goneril Capp|Goneril]], [[Regan Capp|Regan]], [[Kent Capp|Kent]], and the late [[Cordelia Capp]], and the great-great-grandmother of [[Juliette Monty|Juliette]], [[Hermia Capp|Hermia]], [[Tybalt Capp|Tybalt]], [[Miranda Capp|Miranda]], [[Hal Capp|Hal]], [[Desdemona Capp|Desdemona]], and [[Ariel Capp]].

Queen, like [[Priam Albion]], her daughter, and her husband, can be added to the family for a brief second through the [[Tombstone of Life and Death]]. If the game is paused, and the player directs her to do something, the player can have her stay for a bit longer. But in order for Queen to reappear permanently, her "Death Token" must be removed through [[Package editor#SimPE|SimPE]]. According to her SimDNA in SimPE, her hair was red before it turned gray. According to her age data, she had 20 days left in the [[elder]] [[life stage]] when she [[death|died]].

Although Queen has [[memories]] of her husband, unlike most pre-made deceased [[Sim]]s from Veronaville, she doesn't have the memory of Andromache's birth. Her great-granddaughter Goneril has dominant and recessive genetics for red hair, though Queen is the only one of Goneril's ancestors who has genetics for red hair. Queen uses the 10th face template and a slightly customized 1st nose template.

|After the Great Sloth Invasion, '''Princess Cordelia''' was forced to flee her palace with few belongings and take refuge in the country. One of the first places she settled was Henford-on-Bagley. '''Mom Landgraab''' is a [[Sim]] featured in [[The Sims (console)|''The Sims'']] for console and ''[[The Sims Bustin' Out (console)|The Sims Bustin' Out]]'' for console. The player's Sim starts out living with her in [[Mom's house]] in [[SimValley]] in the [[Game guide:Get a Life mode walkthrough|Get a Life storyline]] in ''The Sims'' and [[Game guide:Bust Out Mode walkthrough|Bust Out Mode]] in ''The Sims Bustin' Out''.

==Biography==
=== Life leading up to The Sims (console) ===
In [[The Sims (console)|the console version of ''The Sims'']], Mom is featured as an elderly woman living with her child (the player's Sim) in her home. Unlike in ''[[The Sims Bustin' Out (console)|The Sims Bustin' Out]]'', Mom is playable. Once she has disrupted the player's Sims' daydream, Mom has strict expectations for them and will constantly nag. If the player asks Mom to do any sort of housework (including cooking, cleaning, repairing, etc.), she will refuse to do it, thus placing the burden on the player's Sim. ("I'm not a maid!") She will also make messes herself and nag the player's Sim to clean up after her.

The only two ways to keep the house clean are to keep a "Meet Major Dormo" in the backyard, or hold out a chance for Mom to be abducted by aliens with the Horrorwitz "Star-Track" Backyard Telescope. After the abduction, a neater personality should replace her original one. However, it is nearly impossible to get abducted in story mode. Mom can sometimes be made to cook after completing the 'Cook Dinner' goal by replacing the fridge and stove, which don't have to be the same model as the originals. Mom also has 4 [[cooking]] [[skill]] points, which is most likely to stop her from causing a fire if she or the player makes her cook.

The player can move out of Mom's home after they have warmed Mom up to them and ''"borrowed"'' §800 from her. They can then move into the [[Reality Bites]] house. Mom periodically visits the player Sim, but can be very cruel to them by insulting, slapping, and teasing them. Rarely, she'll bring some flowers in a vase for your Sim. However, clicking on them will result in the option "clean up."

Towards the end of the game, Mom will get married to [[Malcolm Landgraab (console)|Malcolm Landgraab]], and she moves into his house, leaving the player's Sim [[The Last Simoleon|Malcolm's "drafty old mansion"]] where they can live with their spouse and two children for the final level of the game. This makes Mom the stepmother of Malcolm's children, [[Mimi Landgraab|Mimi]] and [[Dudley Landgraab|Dudley]].

Mom is interested in Music, Outdoors, and Money.

=== Life leading up to The Sims Bustin' Out===
In ''[[The Sims Bustin' Out (console)|The Sims Bustin' Out]]'', Mom is featured as an older woman wearing a green facial mask, along with a pink bathrobe and pink bunny slippers. She is the mother of the player's Sim, ex-wife of the infamous [[Malcolm Landgraab]], and former stepmother of [[Mimi Landgraab|Mimi]] and [[Dudley Landgraab|Dudley]]. Mom lives in a quaint country home, surrounded by farms. In this game, she is a lot nicer to the player's Sim. While still a bit of a nag, Mom will look after the player's Sim and prepare food, but when it comes to jobs around the house, she can be a slacker.

When the player first begins to play, the Sim is in a nightclub setting and must kiss either [[Peter Tutti]] or [[Candi Frutti]] (depending on the player's Sim's gender). Mom then pops up out of what seems to be thin air and tells the player's Sim to stop daydreaming and lectures the player's Sim because Malcolm is stealing their motor scooter. The player is then pulled back into reality, and the setting changes to the front of Mom's house, where the Player's Sim was daydreaming.

At Mom's, they must complete a set of five pre-decided goals, including "Find a Job". Until the Sim uses the newspaper to do this, Mom will nag them repeatedly. Her nags can be ignored, and the player can remain living in her home, but that is up to the player to decide. This is a great level to raise some skills before trying a career. Living in Mom's House at any point in the game will freeze the Sim's work schedule and stop all relationship decay. Many motives will also freeze or slow, and should the player deplete all of their money, a seemingly random phone call will supply more.

=== Life leading up to The Urbz ===
Though Mom does not appear in ''The Urbz'' (the only first-generation console game in which this is the case), she is mentioned near the beginning of the game. ''The Urbz'' takes place after ''The Sims Bustin' Out'', and the player moves into an apartment. [[Will.i.am]] will text the player that your Mom called, wishing you well and passes you §300 from her to start you off with, and he gives the player a refrigerator (found in every District), a sofa (from his district, Cosmo Street), and a shower (from The Foundry).

=== Life leading up to The Sims 4 ===
Mom appears alongside her husband and step-children in [[The Sims 4 Gallery]].<ref>[https://www.ea.com/games/the-sims/the-sims-4/gallery/item/q5Scv32fEemG2Sap4Tf15w The Landgraab Family by Maxis]</ref> She also carries a special message in her career slot that is unique to her. The message reads as follows - "Good old Mom! Mom is full of unconditional support. She is always there for you. Always supportive. Always trying to guide you, to show you the way, to control you". Technically, Mom is considered self-employed, and she has no skills when first played. 

Her relationship to Malcolm is fairly average, but she only considers her step-children acquaintances. Her appearance is a mash-up of her previous two looks; she has the pink bathrobe and bunny slippers from ''Bustin' Out'', and her glasses, skintone, and hairstyle are from ''The Sims'' for consoles.

==Trivia==
*Mom is unwilling to build her [[cooking]] and [[mechanical]] skill, but she is willing to build her [[Creativity (skill)|creativity]], [[body]], [[logic]], and [[charisma]].
*If the player kisses Mom in ''The Sims'' for console, it will be a "friendly" kiss, as no romantic music will play, and a romantic relationship will not be formed.
**Mom will always decline all other romantic interactions except for the "Play" in the "Heart-Shaped Hot Tub". If the Player and Mom do this, a romantic relationship can form, and Mom will then accept all other forms of romantic interaction. This also enables the "Should we have a baby?" interaction, though any child will be removed from the game upon completing the level.
*Although it is stated that she is the mother of the player, the parent status was not included in ''The Sims'' until ''The Sims 2'' and ''The Sims Stories'' introduced it.
**Also, even in ''The Sims 2'' era, it is not possible without cheats to have an adult be a parent of another adult. However, it is possible if a teen ages to an adult while the parent is still an adult. If the teen ages while their parent is still an adult, the current adult will still be a parent of the new adult.
*Since Mom is presumed to be the player Sim's mother, this would make them the step-sibling of Mimi and Dudley, and the step-child of Malcolm in the game.
*Her name 'Mom' should not be confused with the 'Mother' relationship status seen in the more recent games from [[The Sims (series)|''The Sims'' series]].
*Although Mom has the appearance of an elder, she is an adult by game mechanics. This is because elders did not appear until ''The Sims 2'' and ''The Sims Stories'' introduced them.
*Although she is the ex-wife of Malcolm, she cannot be married in ''The Sims Bustin' Out''. If the player tries to marry her, the player will get a message stating "Sorry, but I'm already spoken for, try one of the Sims on Free Street 1, 2, or 3." This also occurs for other Sims who do not live in Free Street.
*In ''The Sims Bustin' Out'', if the radio station is switched to techno or rap, Mom can be seen dancing for hours or even days.
*Mom can also be seen in the front right, clapping for the player during the ending movie for ''The Sims'' for console.
*If Mom dies somehow in ''The Sims'' console version or in ''The Sims Bustin' Out'', a [[game over]] will occur, forcing the player to restart from the beginning, or if the player saved, reload the save file and lose progress since then.
*If Mom is [[hypnotized]] in [[The Sims Bustin' Out (console)|''The Sims Bustin' Out'' for console]], she will fall asleep only to be woken up at the player's command. The same applies to [[Mortimer Goth]].
*If Mom is indeed the player character's mother in ''[[The Urbz: Sims in the City (console)|The Urbz]]'', then this may make her the mother of [[Jayde]] and the grandmother of [[Ollie Mark]].
